properties.audience_identity: People who value visceral, female-led martial-arts action and underdog dramas—those drawn to physical stuntcraft, gritty low-budget aesthetics, and emotionally grounded stories about family and survival.

properties.style_description: The film employs gritty, kinetic handheld camerawork and tight close-quarters choreography to produce a raw, realistic visual style with low-budget polish.

short_descriptions.value: A former underground fighter returns to train her sister and other women in illegal fights to pay off debts and confront the promoter controlling the circuit.
Eine ehemalige Kämpferin kehrt zurück, um ihre Schwester und andere Frauen für illegale Kämpfe zu trainieren, Schulden zu begleichen und sich dem Promoter zu stellen.
Una exluchadora regresa para entrenar a su hermana y a otras mujeres en peleas clandestinas para saldar deudas y enfrentarse al promotor que controla el circuito.
Une ancienne combattante revient entraîner sa sœur et d'autres femmes dans des combats clandestins pour rembourser des dettes et affronter le promoteur du circuit.

properties.situational_contexts: Often watched when viewers want a punchy, late-night action film or a group movie night featuring martial-arts choreography, revenge arcs, or female-led combat stories.
properties.plot_themes_description: The film explores redemption and sisterhood amid survival-driven choices, focusing on how debt, corrupt promoters, and family bonds shape the characters' paths.
properties.emotional_tone_description: Gritty and adrenaline-fueled yet emotionally grounded, the film blends raw fight sequences with a warm, urgent story about sisterhood and redemption.
